Identified as this saint because: A 14th-15th-century icon at Hilandar, described on Commons as 'The Holy Martyrs Eustratius, Auxentius, Eugene, Mardarius and Orestes' and filed in Category:Martyrs Eustratios, Auxentios, Eugenios, Mardarios and Orestes. Auxentius is named there as the companion of Eustratius, which is how the feast of 13 December keeps him. Commons describes it: The Holy Martyrs Eustratius, Auxentius, Eugene, Mardarius and Orestes. Hilandar. 14-15th century
